questions.question: How do you align a cross-functional team around a shared vision?
questions.ideal_answer: Establish a clear, compelling vision and tie daily objectives directly to business outcomes. Maintain transparent communication, foster psychological safety, set clear ownership and OKRs/KPIs, and recognize individual and team contributions to maintain momentum.
key_points: Articulates a clear vision and strategic goals
Connects team members' work to high-level objectives
Encourages open feedback and psychological safety
Uses frameworks like OKRs to track progress

questions.question: Describe a time when you had to lead a project through significant ambiguity.
questions.ideal_answer: Use STAR method: explain how you gathered available data, framed key assumptions, created incremental milestones, established feedback loops, and empowered team members while staying flexible as new information emerged.
key_points: Identifies key risks and tests core assumptions early
Breaks down ambiguous goals into actionable steps
Communicates transparently with team and executives
Adapts plans flexibly without losing direction
Demonstrates calm and decisiveness under uncertainty
